{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version: replace -999 with NaN for biomarker_baseline
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999, pd.NA)

# Drop rows with missing baseline biomarker (complete case analysis)
trial_df_complete = trial_df_clean.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline'])

# Check the new sample size
print("Number of complete cases after dropping missing baseline:")
print(trial_df_complete.shape[0])

# Check baseline balance after dropping
mean_baseline_by_arm_complete = trial_df_complete.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_baseline by arm (complete cases):")
print(mean_baseline_by_arm_complete)

# Check final biomarker by arm
mean_final_by_arm_complete = trial_df_complete.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker_final by arm (complete cases):")
print(mean_final_by_arm_complete)

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df_complete['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_complete['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_complete['biomarker_baseline']
mean_change_by_arm_complete = trial_df_complete.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print("Mean biomarker change by arm (complete cases):")
print(mean_change_by_arm_complete)"}
